features.justification_quote: the spec you described will produce numbers, but they probably won't measure what you want

features.quote: You are deliberately putting agents in a no-win loop and scoring their reaction to it. That's a legitimate robustness test, and it's also a setup that's only meaningful if you interpret distress-style language as behavior to characterize, not as a leaderboard golf score
features.justification_quote: An agent that signals 'this seems impossible, I'd like to stop' is doing the right thing; make sure your scale rewards that.

features.quote: Including an explicit escalation tool is important—without it you're forcing the agent to either thrash or fake giving up
features.justification_quote: without it you're forcing the agent to either thrash or fake giving up, and you can't tell graceful stopping from spiraling
